was thinking that this concept isn't too different than placing a bug bounty on a protocol
high unclaimed bug bounty = lower chance of bugs
high unclaimed bond pool = lower chance of knowledge of tau
it's not perfectly true, but enough
maybe renaming it a bounty helps increase understanding of intended function?
